gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: I'll pay you ___ as soon as I get paid.
gaps.explanation: pay somebody back = return borrowed money; pay off a debt = finish paying it.

gaps.sentence: The ministry tried to play ___ the incident.
gaps.explanation: play down = make something seem less important (opposite: play up).

gaps.sentence: He stole the pens and got away ___ it.
gaps.explanation: get away with something = do wrong without being punished.

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.
